description.p: Open Download Manager accelerates downloads with multiple connections, resumes interrupted transfers, schedules queues and integrates with your browser.

ul.li: Up to 32 connections per file, with dynamic segmentation
Resume across pauses, crashes and restarts
Queues with a scheduler, and speed limits
A site grabber and a browser extension that hands downloads over

description.p: On KDE Plasma it starts its Kirigami interface, elsewhere its GTK and libadwaita one.
